title: feat(spec,console): a `type: 'flow'` action may declare `onSuccess`, and the console navigates after a run that completes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbK3S53FNy4JF9JjaiJuZu7X)_

Fixes #25800

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added

## Summary

A `type: 'flow'` action that creates a record could not take the user to it: `ActionSchema` refused `onSuccess` beside `type: 'flow'`, and the page action rows refused it beside a `flow` executor. This PR admits `flow` into the one executor set both read (`ON_SUCCESS_EXECUTORS` in `packages/spec/src/ui/action-on-success-executor.ts`), rewords the refusal prose for `url`, `navigation`, `modal` and `form` to name the three executors, opens the Studio action form's `onSuccess` row to a flow action, and regenerates the reference docs.

On the console side, the post-success hop fires after a flow run that **completes** and never after one that pauses at a screen or ends refused. On a completed run, `${result.*}` reads the run's answer (`AutomationResult`), so `${result.output.VAR}` resolves to one of the flow's `isOutput` variables:

```ts
{
  name: 'start_renewal',
  type: 'flow',
  target: 'renewal_start',
  onSuccess: { navigate: '/apps/clm/clm_contract/record/${result.output.renewal.id}' },
}
// the flow declares variables: [{ name: 'renewal', type: 'object', isOutput: true }]
// and its create_record node writes outputVariable: 'renewal'
```

## Mechanism-assumption correction: why `silent` cannot mark a hand-off

The dispatch assumed the ActionRunner needed no change: the launch judge's `paused` and `refused` arms already answer `silent: true`, so it looked as if the hop could be keyed off that. Measured, it cannot. `silent` is a fact about the **toast** alone, and the `done` arm sets it too. When the flow's own `successMessage` wins the toast (objectui#12274), `judgeFlowLaunch` returns `{ success: true, data, reload, silent: true }` for a run that **completed**. A runner that skipped the hop on `silent` would therefore drop the hop for every completed flow that authors its own success copy, which is exactly the record-creating flow this card is about. The three success arms are indistinguishable on `success` and `silent`, so the runner needs a fact of its own.

That fact is the new `ActionResult.handedOff` (`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`): the success is a hand-off to a follow-up surface, not a completion. `judgeFlowLaunch` sets it on the `paused` and `refused` arms, and `ActionRunner.handlePostExecution` gates the hop on `result.success && !result.handedOff && action.onSuccess`. The seat approved the file-surface amendment (types, core, app-shell) before the console half was written.

## Each launch arm and its hop

`judgeFlowLaunch` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts` now states the hop conclusion for every arm in its docblock, and each conclusion is pinned by a test that runs the real `ActionRunner`:

| Arm | Result | Hop | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `failed` | `success: false` | none | The runner hops only after a success. |
| `paused` | `success: true`, `silent`, `handedOff` | none, now or later | The action only opened the wizard. Navigating away would leave the screen behind, and the run has not answered with the output the hop reads. `FlowRunner` finishing the run later does not hop either. |
| `refused` | `success: true`, `silent`, `handedOff` | none | The Close-only notice is the follow-up, and a hop would navigate past it to a record the refusal never produced. |
| `done` | `success: true`, `data` = `AutomationResult` (`silent` when the flow's copy wins) | hops | The run completed. `${result.*}` reads `data`; `${result.output.VAR}` is an `isOutput` variable. Not `handedOff`, whether `silent` or not. |

## Landing point and surface delta

The claim named the spec half (`action-on-success-executor.ts`, `action.zod.ts`, `component.zod.ts`, `action.form.ts`, their tests, the liveness ledger, the reference docs) and the console tests. The correction above added three source files to the surface, approved by the seat: `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` (`handedOff`), `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` (the gate) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts` (the arms). Following from those:

- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is re-recorded because the registry sources moved; `sdui.manifest.json` itself is byte-identical (106 components). No conflict with #25903 arose, so main was not merged.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts` recounts the predicate census (63) because the form gate is now spelled `data.type in ['api','script','flow']`.
- Eight console view tests (`useConsoleActionRuntime.*`, `RecordDetailView.*`) that pin the paused or refused result with `toEqual` now include `handedOff: true`.

## Premise check: what `${result.output.VAR}` reads

The card reported a run answering `output: {}`. The runtime is not dropping anything: `AutomationResult.output` is built from the flow's `isOutput` variables only (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`, the "Collect output variables" loop at about line 5643), and both the trigger route and the action door (`dispatchFlowAction`, `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`) serve that answer. A `create_record` node writes the record object into its `outputVariable`, but the variable reaches `output` only when the flow declares it `isOutput: true`. The empty `output` is a flow-authoring gap in the reporting app: declare the variable `isOutput: true` and point `outputVariable` at it. The spec docblock and the changeset now say so, and a test pins that an empty `output` resolves the template to `/apps/clm/clm_contract/record/` rather than throwing.

## Tests

Measured on this branch. The spec and ui core/types suites ran at `344ac6f5`, which differs from the head only in `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`; the app-shell suite and the type-checks ran at the head, `9cb24ac6`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 722 passed (722), Tests 21877 passed, 1 todo.
- `ui/` vitest over `packages/core` and `packages/types`: Test Files 601 passed (601), Tests 14680 passed, 27 skipped.
- `ui/` vitest over `packages/app-shell`: Test Files 1721 passed, 1 skipped (1722); Tests 15875 passed, 9 skipped.
- `pnpm run type-check` in `ui/packages/types`, `ui/packages/core` and `ui/packages/app-shell` (after building the app-shell dependency closure): exit 0, 0 errors each.
- New pins: `ActionRunner.onSuccessNavigation.test.ts` (reads `${result.output.renewal.id}` to `/apps/clm/clm_contract/record/ctr_18`; a `silent` completed run still hops; a `handedOff` success does not, with a positive control on the same runner) and a `flowResponse.test.ts` block composing `interpretFlowResponse`, `judgeFlowLaunch` and the real `ActionRunner` for all four arms plus the empty-`output` case.
- Spec: `action-on-success.test.ts` and `component-action-row-on-success-executor.test.ts` move `flow` from refused to accepted and parse the renewal template.

## Ablation

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the runner gate `if (result.success && !result.handedOff && action.onSuccess) {` with `if (result.success && action.onSuccess) {` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `3aebb3cab4ea` to `ac1fc1dff4a2`) and ran the two new test files: Test Files 2 failed (2), Tests 3 failed, 70 passed. The three reds are exactly the hand-off pins: the core "handed-off success performs no hop" test, and the paused and refused composition tests. The file was restored to its HEAD blob `3aebb3cab4ea` with `git diff HEAD` empty. This was a one-time proof; no permanent test file was added for it.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `9cb24ac6` (125 commands), each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: "125 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 123 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED". The 123 that ran exited 0, among them `check:generated`, `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:liveness`, `check:exported-any`, `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:type-check-debt` (re-measured under the verify lock: "26 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number") and `check:nul-bytes`.

Not measured locally, left to CI: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full workspace `pnpm build`) and `check:i18n` (needs the CLI's build closure). Both refused on their prerequisite with exit 3 before reading anything; this diff adds no i18n key and changes no package's build shape.

Two environment notes. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` reads a fixture pinned to commit `621a4876`, which this shallow clone lacked; after fetching that one commit it exits 0. And an earlier sweep ran unlocked while the console manifest regeneration rebuilt `packages/spec/dist`, which produced spurious `check:generated` and `check:exported-any` reds; that sweep was discarded and the numbers above come from the clean rerun.

## Acceptance notes

- Two pre-existing runner behaviours still apply to a handed-off success, unchanged by this PR: an action authored with `refreshAfter: true` sets `result.reload`, and an authored `chain` runs. Neither is new, and neither is the hop this card asked about. Noted, not filed.
- A flow action whose target flow starts at a screen will always pause, so its `onSuccess` can never fire. A publish-time hint for that pairing would catch the mistake earlier; noted, not filed.
